prompts.prompt: Horizontal 3:2 photorealistic editorial interior photograph for a rental bathroom planning guide. Compact modest American bathroom with white bathtub alcove, simple white square wall tiles, straight chrome curtain rod and evenly spaced plain rings. Semi-transparent plain shower liner hangs inside the bathtub, a cream decorative fabric curtain gathered neatly to the left outside the tub. Lower liner hem is clearly inside tub and hangs above the tub bottom without pooling. Water off, dry clean floor, safe uncluttered space, no extra rods, no luxury fixtures, soft daylight. No people, writing, labels, logos or text overlay.
